messages.content: Maintain one rolling project/conversation summary, at most 1536 cl100k tokens. Use only PRIOR SUMMARY and NEW EVENTS, never assume unseen history. Keep durable goals, decisions, constraints, preferences, tasks, progress, questions and facts likely useful later. Retain exact evidence IDs. Apply explicit supersedes/retracts/resolves; preserve unresolved conflicting claims, who said them and uncertainty. Agent inferences are not user confirmations. Drop incidental chatter.
